INTRODUCTION

The Body Computer Node (NBC) is an electronic component comprising a hardware base and a software - hardware interface (ILM).

The NBC guarantees the following functions:

- bodywork functions (lighting, visibility, memorizing, passenger compartment protection, etc.)

- functions of connection between the various multiplate networks;

- bridging functions between through and multiplate functions;

- diagnostic functions;

- acquiring data coming from the sensors;

- distribute and protect power supplies to devices supplied through the body computer;

- manage communication protocols of devices connected to the CAN networks.

The NBC interfaces with the other vehicle nodes by means of three networks:

- a multi-master type CAN known as an intersystems network (I.S.) which connects the NBC to the nodes which supervise the mechanics in general (engine management, ABS, information for the driver, etc.),

- a second CAN network, multi-master type VAN known as a COMFORT network which connects the NBC to the information or comfort equipment.

- a master/slave CAN network known as a CAR network that connects the NBC to the safety and service equipment.

The NBC is also connected to some sensors and actuators and to the diagnostic socket.

NBC ROLE AND FUNCTIONS

The NBC carries out the following processing:

- it manages the system operating status;

- it runs the application program;

- it loads codes and manages the diagnostic line;

- it guarantees time management (timer and delays);

- it communicates via the CAN networks;

- it acquires direct inputs;

- it allows the diagnosis of some direct outlets;

- it provides power supplies.

Nbc trim levels

The are 3 possible different NBC configurations.

In the low range configuration the NBC implements the following functions:

- front electric windows;

- heated seats;

- automatic climate control with dusk and air temperature sensor;

- central locking for the doors;

- rear windscreen wiper.

In the mid-range configuration the NBC implements the following functions:

- automatic climate control with dusk and air temperature sensor;

- front sill light (under the door),

- front electric windows;

- rear electric windows;

- electric child locks;

- heated seats;

- central locking for the doors;

- rear windscreen wiper.

In the top of the range configuration the NBC implements the following functions:

- rain sensor information management,

- automatic switching on of the lights;

- automatic climate control with dusk and air temperature sensor;

- front sill light (under the door),

- front electric windows;

- rear electric windows;

- electric child locks;

- heated seats;

- super locking;

- rear windscreen wiper.

Operating procedure

The multiplexer offers four operating modes:

- "inactive system", which corresponds to body computer off status;

- "system in stand-by", which corresponds to key off status (absence of +15 signal);

- "system active", which corresponds to staus of key inserted and turned to ON or START-UP (presence of +15 signal) during which all functions are active, particularly CAN network communication;

- "system activating", defines the stage when the body computer is activated (this status includes software initialisation).

ACTIVATED

There are three ways to activate the body computer node:

- activation via bus, which takes place using the remote control;

- activation by turning the ignition key to ON or START-UP;

- activation by manual operation of vehicle accesses or the passenger compartment lighting system.

FORCED ELECTRICAL LOAD ACTIVATION/DEACTIVATION

The NBC is equipped with a control function for the electrical loads to prevent overloading (deactivation of electrical consumers) or to force the engagement of the alternator (activation of electrical consumers).

Forced deactivation of electric loads

The load deactivation function is designed to prevent the battery from being run down or even destroyed through the application of temporary current interruptions.

The NBC intervention levels are as follows:

- level 0: no deactivation;

- level 1: interruption of heater plugs power supply (if supplied for the function of the artificial regeneration of the particle filter),

- level 2: interruption of engine cooling fan power supply, at medium speed (if supplied for the function of the artificial regeneration of the particulate filter),

- level 3: interruption of engine cooling fan power supply, at medium speed (if supplied for the function of the artificial regeneration of the particulate filter),

- level 4: interruption of the heated rear windscreen power supply (if supplied for the function of the artificial regeneration of the particle filter),

- level 5: interruption of the power supply to the heated rear window (if the activation time exceeds six minutes) if authorised by the climate control node;

- level 6: reduction in the climate control fan speed (with automatic climate control);

- level 7: interruption of the compressor power supply (with automatic climate control).

With a manually operated climate control system, the compressor is not switched off because the NBC does not recognize the climate control fan rotation speed.

Forced activation of electric loads

The forced activation of certain electrical loads required by the Engine Management Node for the regeneration of the particulate filter does not take priority.

The forced activation levels are as follows:

- level 0: no forced activation,

- level 1: heated rear windscreen power supply;

- level 2: power supply of engine cooling fan, low speed;

- level 3: power supply of engine cooling fan, medium speed;

- level 4: glow plug power supply.
